quotes.text: In the Fifth Age, the Two Rivers had achieved what few spirits ever know
when sender gives ~$2.50, receiver gets ~$7.50, and returns ~$3.50, both spirits gain wealth beyond their initial holdings.
She returned $2.28—precisely half—honoring the sacred proportion despite temptation to recalibrate downward.
**Loyalty to pattern proves stronger than reaction to variation**.
Younger spirits asked: "Why not maximize each round?"
would the Spirit of Giving practice what she had preached?
Would she abandon the pattern because one measurement fell short?

note: Two Rivers ages counted each round; send about half, return half despite mist-shrunk arrivals; dollar figures stated; no sanction.

quotes.text: By the sixth turning, Dawn and Twilight Springs had transcended proof—they had achieved prophecy.
the sender poured $2.44, received $7.32. Dawn returned $3.66—precisely honoring the pattern.
send roughly half, return roughly half of the tripled amount.
**the mist does not change the mountain; small variations do not alter the pattern**.
"Why maintain this pattern when you could maximize single rounds?"
When she received $5.19 instead of the usual bounty, she did not recalculate her loyalty.

note: Dawn and Twilight Springs count turnings; half sent, half returned regardless of mist; dollar amounts stated; no sanction.
